+package options

+import (
+	"testing"

+
+func TestAIModelFlagDefault(t *testing.T) {
+	opts := NewAIOptions()
+	fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("test", pflag.ContinueOnError)
+	opts.AddFlags(fs)
+	require.NoError(t, fs.Parse(nil))
+
+	// gpt-3.5-turbo is shut down by OpenAI on 2026-10-23.
+	require.Equal(t, "gpt-5.6-terra", opts.AIModel)
+}
+
+func TestAIModelDefaultIsKeptForOpenAI(t *testing.T) {
+	opts := NewAIOptions()
+	fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("test", pflag.ContinueOnError)
+	opts.AddFlags(fs)
+	require.NoError(t, fs.Parse(nil))
+
+	cfg := &registry.ExtraConfig{}
+	require.NoError(t, opts.ApplyTo(cfg))
+	require.Equal(t, "gpt-5.6-terra", cfg.AIModel)
+}
+
+func TestAIModelDefaultIsDroppedForOtherBackends(t *testing.T) {
+	opts := NewAIOptions()
+	fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("test", pflag.ContinueOnError)
+	opts.AddFlags(fs)
+	require.NoError(t, fs.Parse([]string{"--ai-backend=huggingface"}))
+
+	cfg := &registry.ExtraConfig{}
+	require.NoError(t, opts.ApplyTo(cfg))
+	require.Empty(t, cfg.AIModel)
+}

+package ai
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+const openAIChatReply = `{"id":"1","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"ok"},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`
+
+// requestBodyFor configures an OpenAIClient against a test server and returns the
+// JSON body sent by Generate.
+func requestBodyFor(t *testing.T, temperature, topP float32) map[string]any {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	var body map[string]any
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		raw, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &body))
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(openAIChatReply))
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+
+	c := &OpenAIClient{}
+	require.NoError(t, c.Configure(AIConfig{
+		AuthToken:   "test-token",
+		Model:       "gpt-5.6-terra",
+		BaseURL:     server.URL,
+		Temperature: temperature,
+		TopP:        topP,
+	}))
+
+	_, err := c.Generate(context.Background(), "hello")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return body
+}
+
+func TestOpenAIClient_Generate_OmitsDefaultTopP(t *testing.T) {
+	body := requestBodyFor(t, 1, 1)
+
+	assert.NotContains(t, body, "top_p")
+	assert.EqualValues(t, 1, body["temperature"])
+}
+
+func TestOpenAIClient_Generate_SendsCustomTopP(t *testing.T) {
+	body := requestBodyFor(t, 1, 0.5)
+
+	assert.EqualValues(t, 0.5, body["top_p"])
+}
